title: Improving the adaptive and continuous learning capabilities of artificial neural networks: Lessons from multi-neuromodulatory dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2501.06762v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Continuous adaptive learning, the ability to adapt to the environment and keep improving performance, is a hallmark of natural intelligence. Biological organisms excel in acquiring, transferring, and retaining knowledge while adapting to volatile environments, making them a source of inspiration for artificial neural networks (ANNs). This study explores how neuromodulation, a building block of learning in biological systems, can help address catastrophic forgetting and enhance the robustness of ANNs in continual learning. translated_title: 提升人工神经网络的自适应与持续学习能力：来自多神经调质动力学的启示
translated_abstract: 持续自适应学习，即适应环境并不断提升性能的能力，是自然智能的一大标志。生物有机体在获取、迁移和保留知识的同时能够适应多变的环境，这使其成为人工神经网络（ANN）的灵感来源。本研究探讨了神经调质——生物系统中学习的基本构件——如何帮助解决灾难性遗忘问题，并增强人工神经网络在持续学习中的鲁棒性。在多巴胺（DA）、乙酰胆碱（ACh）、血清素（5-HT）和去甲肾上腺素（NA）等神经调质的驱动下，大脑中的神经调质过程在多个尺度上运作，通过从局部突触可塑性到全局网络范围适应性等多种机制，实现对环境变化的动态响应。重要的是，神经调质之间的关系及其在调节过程中的相互作用……
tldr: 本研究借鉴大脑中多巴胺、乙酰胆碱、血清素和去甲肾上腺素等多种神经调质在多尺度上的动态调节机制，为提升人工神经网络的持续学习能力、缓解灾难性遗忘提供了新思路。
en_tdlr: This study draws on multi-scale neuromodulatory dynamics involving dopamine, acetylcholine, serotonin, and noradrenaline in the brain to improve the continual learning capabilities of artificial neural networks and mitigate catastrophic forgetting.
